trades.reasoning: ALAB has a perfect score of 100 with all four confirmation signals: RSI 60.2 in the bullish zone, a bullish MACD crossover with a rising histogram, price above its SMA-20, and a volume surge that points to institutional buying.

SMTC also scores 100 with full multi-signal confirmation (RSI 57.4, rising MACD histogram, price above SMA-20, volume surge), and its lower share price makes it a good use of the remaining cash if ALAB can't be filled.

decisions.briefing: Markets rallied sharply today, with the NASDAQ up 6.5% and the S&P 500 up 4.7%, a clear risk-on day led by semiconductors and AI infrastructure stocks. Our lessons say to put cash to work on strong up days like this, so the idle $645 goes to the two top-scoring candidates, ALAB and SMTC, which both show every confirmation signal we look for. All seven existing positions stay open, and the automatic profit targets and stop-losses will manage the exits.

market_education.summary_en: US stocks rose broadly today, with the tech-heavy NASDAQ up 6.5% and the S&P 500 up 4.7%. Chip and AI-infrastructure names led the move: ALAB, SMTC, MTSI, TSEM, NVDA and MU all show bullish MACD crossovers and prices above their 20-day averages. Several also traded on unusually high volume, which suggests big institutions were buying. No news headlines came with today's data, so no specific news catalyst can be cited, and the explanation rests only on price and volume behaviour.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面急升，以科技股為主的納斯達克指數大漲6.5%，標普500指數亦升4.7%。半導體及AI基建股領漲，ALAB、SMTC、MTSI、TSEM、NVDA及MU等個股均出現MACD黃金交叉，股價亦企穩20日均線之上；其中多隻股份成交量明顯放大，反映大型機構資金積極入市。由於今日數據未附相關新聞標題，未能引述具體消息催化因素，以上分析僅基於價格及成交量表現。

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-on rally is a day when investors feel confident and move money into riskier, faster-growing assets such as tech and chip stocks, so major indexes jump together. Today's 6.5% NASDAQ gain is a strong example. Active traders often use days like this to put idle cash to work, but they still pick stocks with several confirming signals instead of buying whatever is rising.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「風險偏好上升行情」（Risk-On Rally）是指投資者信心高漲，資金湧向科技股、半導體股等較高風險但增長較快的資產，帶動主要指數同步急升。今日納指大漲6.5%正是典型例子。積極型投資者往往會趁這類日子將閒置資金投入市場，但仍應挑選具備多重技術訊號確認的股份，而非盲目追捧所有上升中的股票。
